errors.message: 1 bundle selector(s) on built post-purchase page(s) sell into the live cart: "upsell-bundle-1x" on page "upsell-2" (hidden). Each lacks data-next-upsell-context and is in the default "swap" selection mode. Loading the page adds that selector's package to the shopper's LIVE CART with no click, and it is charged at the next checkout without appearing in that checkout's rendered order summary. Add data-next-upsell-context to each selector listed (the post-purchase basket, and upsell pricing), or delete the selector if it exists only to display a price.
